args.sql:
SELECT m.maintregistry, m.maintcostusd, m.cleancostusd, m.replacecostusd, p.gencapmw, 
       (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw as mce
FROM maintenance m
JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
ORDER BY mce DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN mce < 1000 THEN 'Low (<1000)'
    WHEN mce < 3000 THEN 'Medium (1000-3000)'
    WHEN mce < 5000 THEN 'High-Medium (3000-5000)'
    ELSE 'Very High (>5000)'
  END as category,
  COUNT(*) as count
FROM (
  SELECT (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw as mce
  FROM maintenance m
  JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
) sub
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY min(sub.mce);

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_poor_mce_records
FROM maintenance m
JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
WHERE (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw > 300;

SELECT m.maintregistry, (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw as mce
FROM maintenance m
JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
WHERE (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw > 300
ORDER BY mce DESC
LIMIT 5;
